title: 觀瀑圖（1975.95）
holder: 克利夫兰美术馆（藏品号 1975.95）
medium: Hanging scroll; ink and light color on paper
one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「1764」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: Hanging scroll; ink and light color on paper
Mr. and Mrs. William H. Marlatt Fund

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → qing；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Lee, Sherman E. “The Year in Review for 1975.” The Bulletin of the Cleveland Museum of Art 63, no. 2 (February 1976): 31–71.（Reproduced: p. 59; Mentioned: p. 71, no. 161）

Ho, Wai-kam, Sherman E. Lee, Laurence Sickman, and Marc F. Wilson. Eight Dynasties of Chinese Painting: The Collections of the Nelson Gallery-Atkins Museum, Kansas City, and the Cleveland Museum of Art. Cleveland, OH: Cleveland Museum of Art, in cooperation with Indiana University Press, 1980.（Mentioned and Reproduced: cat. no. 271, p. 379）
Yang, Kathleen 楊凱琳, and Chi-chʻien Wang 王季遷. Through a Chinese connoisseur's eye: private notes of C.C. Wang 王季遷讀書筆記. Beijing: Zhong hua shu ju, 2010.（Mentioned: p. 313, no. 38）

dating.text: 馆方著录中有含纪年的款识（见「题跋与鉴藏」一节），其年份与馆方断代一致，故断代依据可以填「款识」而不再是无从得知。**只给「较可靠」不给「确证」**：本库未核对原件，款识本身的真伪、是否后添均未独立判定。
款识原文未经本库目验；馆方亦未说明其对该款识真伪的判断。

colophons.text:
觀瀑圖. 
二月七日為
守堂老伯先生作朱草詩林中人羅聘. 
[印] 兩峰畫印; 山林外臣.

馆方英译：Artist's inscription, signature, and 2 seals: Watching the Waterfall. Done in the jiashen year [1764] for my senior, the venerable Mr. Shoutang. Zhucao shi linzhong ren, Luo Ping. 

[seals] Liangfeng hua yin; Shanlin wai chen.
1 additional seal of C. C. Wang 王季遷 (1907–2003) in the lower right.
以上为克利夫兰美术馆藏品记录里的题跋与钤印著录，**本库未核对原件**；款印的真伪、题跋者身份与年代均未独立判定。

provenance.text: (Ting Chen Chang, Hong Kong, sold to the Cleveland Museum of Art)
The Cleveland Museum of Art, Cleveland, OH
